question: To promote the dialogue of traditions, national values and cultures, India participated in the BRICS Literature Forum 2024 in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Russia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India participated in the BRICS Literature Forum 2024 held in Russia to promote the dialogue of traditions, national values, and cultures among BRICS nations.
 
• The BRICS Literature Forum is a significant event that brings together writers, poets, and literary figures from BRICS countries to discuss and share their cultural and literary heritage.
 
• Russia hosted the 2024 forum, showcasing its commitment to fostering cultural cooperation and mutual understanding among BRICS countries.
 
• The forum included various literary discussions, workshops, and cultural performances aimed at enhancing the literary ties between the member countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BRICS**:

 
 
• BRICS is an acronym for five major emerging economies: Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa.
 
• These countries are known for their significant influence on regional and global affairs.
 
• The BRICS grouping aims to promote peace, security, and development in the global economy.
 
 
 
• **Cultural Exchange Programs**:
 
 
• Cultural exchange programs are initiatives designed to foster mutual understanding and cooperation between different countries.
 
• Such programs often include exchanges in the fields of arts, literature, education, and sports.
 
 
 
• **Literary Forums**:
 
 
• Literary forums are platforms where writers, poets, and literary critics gather to discuss and promote literature.
 
• These forums play a crucial role in preserving and promoting cultural heritage and literary traditions.
 
 
 
• **BRICS Cultural Cooperation**:
 
 
• The BRICS countries have established various cultural cooperation initiatives to enhance mutual understanding and cultural exchange.
 
• These initiatives include film festivals, art exhibitions, and literary forums.
